name: rea
description: Reverse engineer anything from your terminal or agent with one CLI and MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Use REA to explain shipped behavior from native binaries, managed assemblies, Electron and JavaScript bundles, packages, firmware, and browser targets, with evidence that separates observations from inferences.
defaultPrompt: Use REA to explain how this binary implements a feature.
Use REA to compare two versions of this application.
Use REA to recover the sources from this JavaScript bundle.
